_what: FR3 Cube-Stack plant: the two cubes only. The cell (robot, gripper, cameras, mat, curtain, lights) is read from workcell.json.
_source_legend: measured = weighed, ruled, or read off the teleop recording / placeholder = no evidence yet

mass_kg._source_detail: scale, operator; each cube, tape included

static_friction._source_detail: Wrapped in PVC electrical tape. Tape-on-tape decides whether a stack stands: tilt the blue cube with the red one on top until it slips, mu_s = tan(theta).

grasp_width_norm._source_detail: Franka Hand normalised width when closed on a cube, median of 16 episodes (0.625-0.634); 0.63 x 80 mm = 50.4 mm, i.e. no measurable squeeze

linear_rgb._source_detail: render-matched, round 3: two-view fit with diffuse response s from round 1 and emission gain k from round 2, ep13 frame 0, both cameras Round 4: round-3 values x per-channel linear ratio real/sim [0.875, 0.65, 3.6] (both views, frame 0), which keeps the diffuse/emission split.

spawn_pos._source_detail: episode 13: medoid of 12 train red/blue pairs (held out [3, 7, 11, 15]). xy = TCP at grasp onset; z = mat top 32 mm + 25 mm.

yaw_deg._source_detail: hand-x yaw at grasp onset, mod 90

camera_srgb_median._source_detail: median of the colour-segmented cube, ep13 frame 0, both cameras: the target

emission_linear_rgb._source_detail: Stands in for the translucent tape (it reads about as bright from both cameras). Round 3: solved with measured emission-to-pixel gain. Round 4: round-3 values x per-channel linear ratio real/sim [0.875, 0.65, 3.6] (both views, frame 0), which keeps the diffuse/emission split.

linear_rgb._source_detail: render-matched, round 3, left_back only: per-channel diffuse response measured on rounds 1-2 (B 0.236 confirmed by round 2), G from round 2. The wrist view is excluded: at ep13 frame 0 the blue cube is cut by the wrist image's bottom edge and its two rounds disagree. Diffuse only -- blue needs no emission. Round 4: B x1.22 from the round-3 left_back ratio; the in-view wrist frames (230-270) asked for about the same.

spawn_pos._source_detail: episode 13: TCP xy at the last frame before release (the red cube is set down on it); z = mat top 32 mm + 25 mm.

yaw_deg._source_detail: hand-x yaw before release, mod 90: the operator squares the top cube to the bottom one

camera_srgb_median._source_detail: median of the colour-segmented cube, ep13 frame 0, both cameras: the target

emission_linear_rgb._source_detail: round 3: none needed; the blue cube's two views read alike under diffuse alone

success._what: red cube resting on blue: centre height difference one edge, horizontally inside the blue top, and still
